description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Validates one email address without contacting the mailbox: RFC 5321 syntax, domain exists, MX / null-MX / implicit-MX, MX hosts resolve, mail provider, disposable-domain flag (CC0 list), role account (info@, support@), free provider, typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Verdict valid / risky / invalid. ~0.2-1.5 s.
name: email_validate
title: Email address validation (syntax + domain + MX, no SMTP probing)
